svg.text: RV32I five-stage pipeline - datapath of riscv_core_top.sv
Branch, JAL and JALR resolve in EX. ex_redirect flushes IF/ID and ID/EX (2 wrong-path slots) and pc_sel picks the target.
Load-use: hazard_stall holds PC and IF/ID and inserts an ID/EX bubble (1 cycle). Load data forwards only from MEM/WB.
* ex_mem_reg_write = ex_mem_ctrl.reg_write & ex_mem_valid & (wb_sel != LOAD). EX/MEM forwards the ALU result or PC+4.
WB -> ID bypass: a register written in WB is read correctly by the instruction in ID in the same cycle.
Memories sit outside the core (imem_* / dmem_* ports). Valid bits mark bubbles and flushed slots; x0 is never written.
